errors.what: Both gloves have the thumb on the same side and face the same way, so they are two copies of one hand instead of a mirrored left and right pair

cards.fix: a matching pair of red boxing gloves, one left-hand and one right-hand glove, mirror images of each other with thumbs on opposite sides

errors.where: left crash cymbal stand, upper left
errors.what: The cymbal boom arm bends down-left and ends in the air beside the floor tom; it never joins a vertical stand that reaches the floor
The hi-hat on the right stand has only one cymbal (a hi-hat needs a top and bottom pair), and the crash cymbal above is booming off the same pole

cards.fix: left crash cymbal on its own straight stand with a boom arm connected to a vertical pole and tripod legs on the floor; on the right, a hi-hat stand with two stacked cymbals and a separate crash cymbal stand
